question: What Is Under Frequency Load Shedding (UFLS)?
body_html:
Under frequency load shedding is an automatic protection scheme that trips planned distribution feeders in steps when grid frequency falls after a loss of generation, restoring the balance between generation and load before a blackout.

Stage (IEGC 2023)FrequencyRelief
Stage 149.4 Hz5% of peak
Stage 249.2 Hz6% of peak
Stage 349.0 Hz7% of peak
Stage 448.8 Hz7% of peak

Total planned relief is 25% of the previous year peak demand.
